parameters.name: AccountPassword
parameters.description:
The password of the root account. Valid values:

- The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
- Special characters include !@#$%^&*()_+-=
- The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.

> For more information about how to database connection failures caused by special characters in the connection string, see [How do I database connection failures caused by special characters in the account password of a connection string?](~~471568~~).

parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the instance. Valid values:

- **true**: Auto-renewal is enabled.
- **false**: default value. Auto-renewal is disabled. You must manually renew the instance.

> This parameter is available and optional when the **ChargeType** parameter is set to **PrePaid**.

parameters.name: BackupId
parameters.description:
The backup ID. You can call the [DescribeBackups](~~62172~~) operation to query the backup ID.
> This parameter is required only when you call this operation to clone an instance from a backup. You must also specify the **SrcDBInstanceId** parameter.

parameters.name: BusinessInfo
parameters.description: The additional parameter. Business information.

parameters.name: ChargeType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

- **PostPaid**: default value. Pay-as-you-go.
- **PrePaid**: subscription.

> If you set this parameter to **PrePaid**, you must also specify the **Period** parameter.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: CouponNo
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use coupons. Valid values:
- **default** or **null** (default): Coupons are used.
- **youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank**: Coupons are not used.

parameters.name: DBInstanceClass
parameters.description: The instance type. You can call the [DescribeAvailableResource](~~149719~~) operation to query available instance types.

parameters.name: DBInstanceDescription
parameters.description:
The name of the instance. Valid values:

- The name must start with a letter.
- The name can contain digits, letters, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).
- The name must be 2 to 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: DBInstanceStorage
parameters.description:
The instance storage space. Unit: GB.

The valid values are subject to the instance type. For details, see [Replica set instance types](~~311410~~).

parameters.name: DatabaseNames
parameters.description:
The name of the database.
> When you call this operation to clone an instance, you can specify this parameter to clone specific databases. If you do not specify this parameter, all databases of the instance are cloned.

parameters.name: Encrypted
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable cloud disk encryption.

parameters.name: EncryptionKey
parameters.description: The custom encryption key ID.

parameters.name: Engine
parameters.description: The database engine. Set the value to **MongoDB**.

parameters.name: EngineVersion
parameters.description:
The database engine version. Valid values:
- **8.0**
- **7.0**
- **6.0**
- **5.0**
- **4.4**
- **4.2**
- **4.0**

> When you call this operation to clone clone instance or restore clone instance from the recycle bin, set this parameter to the same value as the source instance.

><warning>Version 3.4 and earlier are no longer available for purchase.></warning>

parameters.name: GlobalSecurityGroupIds
parameters.description: The global IP address whitelist templates of the instance. Separate multiple templates with commas (,). Templates cannot be duplicated. This feature is in canary release.

parameters.name: HiddenZoneId
parameters.description:
The zone of the hidden node for multi-zone deployment. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou-g**: Hangzhou Zone G.
- **cn-hangzhou-h**: Hangzhou Zone H.
- **cn-hangzhou-i**: Hangzhou Zone I.
- **cn-hongkong-b**: Hong Kong (China) Zone B.
- **cn-hongkong-c**: Hong Kong (China) Zone C.
- **cn-hongkong-d**: Hong Kong (China) Zone D.
- **cn-wulanchabu-a**: Ulanqab Zone A.
- **cn-wulanchabu-b**: Ulanqab Zone B.
- **cn-wulanchabu-c**: Ulanqab Zone C.
- **ap-southeast-1a**: Singapore Zone A.
- **ap-southeast-1b**: Singapore Zone B.
- **ap-southeast-1c**: Singapore Zone C.
- **ap-southeast-5a**: Jakarta Zone A.
- **ap-southeast-5b**: Jakarta Zone B.
- **ap-southeast-5c**: Jakarta Zone C.
- **eu-central-1a**: Frankfurt Zone A.
- **eu-central-1b**: Frankfurt Zone B.
- **eu-central-1c**: Frankfurt Zone C.

> - This parameter is available when the instance uses cloud disks.
> - The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the values of the **ZoneId** and **SecondaryZoneId** parameters.

parameters.name: NetworkType
parameters.description:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:

**VPC**: VPC.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The subscription period of the instance. Unit: months.

Valid values: **1** to **9** (integer), **12**, **24**, **36**, and **60**.

> This parameter is available and required when the **ChargeType** parameter is set to **PrePaid**.

parameters.name: ProvisionedIops
parameters.description: The provisioned performance (IOPS). Valid values: 0 to 50000.

parameters.name: ReadonlyReplicas
parameters.description: The number of **read-only nodes** in the replica set instance. Valid values: **0** to **5** (integer). Default value: **0**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~61933~~) operation to query the region ID.
> When you call this operation to clone clone instance or restore clone instance from the recycle bin, set this parameter to the same value as the source instance.

parameters.name: ReplicationFactor
parameters.description:
The number of **primary and secondary nodes** in the replica set instance. Valid values:

- **3** (default)
- **5**
- **7**

><notice>You do not need to specify this parameter for standalone instances.></notice>

parameters.name: RestoreTime
parameters.description: The point in time to which you want to restore the instance. You can specify any point in time within the past seven days. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). > This parameter is required only when you call this operation to clone an instance to a point in time. You must also specify the **SrcDBInstanceId** parameter.

parameters.name: RestoreType
parameters.description:
The backup restoration type. Valid values:
- 0: Recovers the instance to a specified backup set.
- 1: Recovers the instance to a specified point in time.
- 2: Recovers a released instance to a specified backup set.
- 3: Recovers the instance to a specified geo-redundancy backup set.

parameters.name: SecondaryZoneId
parameters.description:
The zone of the secondary node for multi-zone deployment. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou-g**: Hangzhou Zone G.
- **cn-hangzhou-h**: Hangzhou Zone H.
- **cn-hangzhou-i**: Hangzhou Zone I.
- **cn-hongkong-b**: Hong Kong (China) Zone B.
- **cn-hongkong-c**: Hong Kong (China) Zone C.
- **cn-hongkong-d**: Hong Kong (China) Zone D.
- **cn-wulanchabu-a**: Ulanqab Zone A.
- **cn-wulanchabu-b**: Ulanqab Zone B.
- **cn-wulanchabu-c**: Ulanqab Zone C.
- **ap-southeast-1a**: Singapore Zone A.
- **ap-southeast-1b**: Singapore Zone B.
- **ap-southeast-1c**: Singapore Zone C.
- **ap-southeast-5a**: Jakarta Zone A.
- **ap-southeast-5b**: Jakarta Zone B.
- **ap-southeast-5c**: Jakarta Zone C.
- **eu-central-1a**: Frankfurt Zone A.
- **eu-central-1b**: Frankfurt Zone B.
- **eu-central-1c**: Frankfurt Zone C.

> - This parameter is available when the instance uses cloud disks.
> - The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the values of the **ZoneId** and **HiddenZoneId** parameters.

parameters.name: SecurityIPList
parameters.description:
The IP address whitelist of the instance. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). IP addresses cannot be duplicated. The following three formats are supported:

- 0.0.0.0/0
- IP address, such as 10.23.12.24.
- CIDR block, such as 10.23.12.0/24, where 24 indicates the length of the prefix in the IP address and the value ranges from 1 to 32.

> - You can add up to 1,000 IP addresses or CIDR blocks to all IP address whitelist groups of an instance.
> - If you set this parameter to 0.0.0.0/0, all IP addresses can access the instance database. Exercise caution when you use this setting.

parameters.name: SrcDBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the source instance.
> When you call this operation to clone an instance, you must specify this parameter and either the **BackupId** or **RestoreTime** parameter. When you call this operation to revoke an instance from the recycle bin, you need to specify only this parameter. You do not need to specify the **BackupId** or **RestoreTime** parameter.

parameters.name: SrcRegion
parameters.description:
The region of the source instance.

> This parameter is required when the backup restoration type is 2 or 3.

parameters.name: StorageEngine
parameters.description:
The storage engine of the instance. Set the value to **WiredTiger**.
> - When you call this operation to clone clone instance or restore clone instance from the recycle bin, set this parameter to the same value as the source instance.
> - For more information about the constraints on storage engines and versions, see [MongoDB versions and storage engines](~~61906~~).

parameters.name: StorageType
parameters.description:
The storage type. Valid values:
- **cloud_essd1**: PL1 ESSD.
- **cloud_essd2**: PL2 ESSD.
- **cloud_essd3**: PL3 ESSD.
- **cloud_auto**: ESSD AutoPL.
- **local_ssd**: local SSD.

> - When you purchase a standalone instance with cloud_essd1, the actual cloud disk type used is cloud_essd.
> - ESSD AutoPL is supported only on the China site (aliyun.com).
> - Instances that run version 4.4 or later use **cloud_essd1** by default.
> - Instances that run version 4.2 or earlier use **local_ssd** by default.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The custom tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The key of the tag.
> **N** specifies the number of the tag. For example, **Tag.1.Key** specifies the key of the first tag, and **Tag.2.Key** specifies the key of the second tag.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The value of the tag.
> **N** specifies the number of the tag. For example, **Tag.1.Value** specifies the value of the first tag, and **Tag.2.Value** specifies the value of the second tag.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The VPC ID.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~61933~~) operation to query the zone ID.
